capabilities: Draw logic gate circuits as SVG with live signal state
Generate truth tables and drive the circuit by clicking rows
Minimise expressions with Karnaugh maps and Quine–McCluskey
Render structural and simplified Boolean expressions as LaTeX
Export truth tables, LaTeX, Mermaid and PNG/SVG diagrams
disambiguation: Not a note-linking or knowledge graph view; it draws and simulates digital logic gate circuits.
extras: The companion image-import extension is marked work in progress and not ready for shipment; truth tables and minimisation are limited to 12 inputs, diagrams and simulation to 32 inputs and 256 gates.
problem: Notes about digital logic cannot draw or simulate gate circuits, so diagrams, truth tables and minimisation have to be made in separate tools.

relations.evidence: The separate Logic Graph – Image Import extension turns a picture of a circuit into a block

summary: Renders logic gate circuits, truth tables, Karnaugh maps and timing diagrams from a plain-text code block.
